messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to speak earlier. We'd like to instruct you on the Westmere Coatings acquisition (Project Willow). Catherine and the IC are supportive of moving quickly. Please send the engagement letter and let's get the NDA out to the Westmere side this week.

Best,
Catherine
